name: Maria A. Gutzeit
office: Santa Clarita Valley Water Agency, Member, Board of Directors, Division 3

items.text: Maria A. Gutzeit is the board president of the Santa Clarita Valley Water Agency and owner of an environmental compliance firm. She participated in the formation of SCV Water through 2018 state legislation. Her campaign says she helped secure over $23 million in grants and that the merger saved ratepayers more than $10 million. Her campaign emphasizes cost control, transparency, and clean water.
